desc:
🌍 In This World... every round is a new rule.

The globe spins. It lands on a world. And this time, YOU'RE the main character.

🔦 One round, the lights go out and something walks the streets. Find the fuses before it finds you.
🌙 The next, a giant face opens its eyes in the sky. Don't move.
💀 The next, one player is born with a 0 over their head... and everyone is coming for them.

⚡ Every world has a twist halfway through. Most people don't survive it.

Rounds are short, the rules are simple, and every round plays out like the videos.
Play with friends. Be the main character. See if the story ends with you.

🐞 This is the BETA. Expect bugs and placeholders. Use the bug button and tell us what you think.
🔥 BIG UPDATE FRIDAY! ⭐ Favorite so you don't miss it.
